topics.title: BI 1291583 (CatC inhibitor) – BE Ph3 (1397-0014) China CTA and Recruitment

background.text: CN approval base case: Mar 2030. Global 1st EC approval obtained from China leading site CHN001 (Huadong Hospital affiliated to Fudan University). Final country allocation released: global target sample size 1642 patients; China commitment 201 patients (TOP1 recruiter); 523 sites allocated globally; China commitment of 54 sites not reduced.
background.quote:
CatCi Phase III (1397-0014) Global 1st EC approval obtained from China leading site CHN001 (Huadong Hospital affiliated to Fudan University).
CatCi Phase III (1397-0014) final country allocation released, the global target sample size are 1642 patients. China commitment 201 patients indicating as the TOP1 recruiter in the listing.

background.text: CDE gave positive feedback on CatCi pediatric development plan (12–<18 years) in Ph3 (1397-0014); China will join global adolescent trial.
background.quote: POSITIVE feedback from CDE regarding CatCi pediatric development plan (12-＜18 years of age) in phase III (1397-0014) trial and China will join global adolescent trial.

todo.text: 60 WD technical review in CDE for CTA for BI 1291583 CatCi Ph3 1397-0014 in BE, target approval by end of May. CMC interaction planned early Jun 2025, CDE feedback expected Aug/Sep 2025. Kick off preparation of China PK study CTP in Sep 2025. Owner: 原文未说明。
todo.quote:

corrected.detail: EC approval from CHN001 is a process/regulatory milestone, not a PEC/CEC committee endorsement; correctly placed in background. No for_endorsement items present, consistent with source.
Todo items lack owner names; added note '原文未说明' to both todo facts to flag the gap rather than leaving it implicit.

not_applicable.detail: No committee-level decisions (PEC/CEC/MAP/etc.) recorded for this topic; decision array is empty.

BE adult Ph3 (1397-0014) and pediatric/adolescent sub-trial are kept in one topic because both share the same study number 1397-0014 and the same CN approval base case; the adolescent arm is an amendment to the same protocol, not a separate indication.
Single asset/study; no cross-asset merging involved.

All four original facts (F0001–F0004) are retained and covered. Slide 3 milestone overview and Slide 4 TA-CEC decisions table are from other assets (Nerandomilast, cGASi) and are not relevant to this topic.
